findings.title: Cockpit footprint over a 2 GB trace is 2.1x the empty-trace footprint, not within ~10%
findings.repro: bun scripts/trace-bench.ts (defaults). Expected cockpit peak RSS ratio ~1.1; observed 2.10 (352 MB vs 167 MB). status ratio 1.00 is fine.
findings.detail: The project view still opens today's day file through local facts' hook read (readHookFacts in loadLocalFacts, window from the live run's start). The read observer shows `norn status --json` opening exactly today's file when a run is live. Per-unit hook files are slice 04 (B8), which this slice puts out of scope. Base code: 52.6x, so the slice removes most of it.

findings.title: trace-bench's synthetic hook facts fail HookFact validation
findings.repro: bun scripts/trace-bench.ts --gb 0.02 --days 16 --hooks 50 --keep, then loadTimelines on the repo: 50 errors `unknown property 'input'` at /fact on each hook line.
findings.detail: Hook facts are built with `input: { command }`; HookFact has `command` and rejects `input`. None of the 420 hooks loads as a fact, so the benchmark under-models the live run, and slice 04's QA reuses it.
